_about: The clinic's answers to what the dry run could not decide for itself.
Every entry here is a person's ruling, not an inference. The migrator
applies them without re-litigating: a clinic-stated identity outranks a
filename, a stored record, or anything this tool worked out on its own.
_initials_rule: An initial nobody knows yet is X, per position. Both unknown gives
XX_MM-DD-YYYY. These are ordinary canonical IDs that route and sync like
any other, and the clinic corrects one whenever they like through a normal
relabel. An unknown initial is never a reason to stop a migration.
Many 1/1 birthdates are from the blacked-out-birthday era and are
approximate; those get corrected the same way.
